verdict.rationale: Working Copy clones from any user-supplied URL over ssh, https, git or http. Its docs describe setting up a regular Linux server, BSD server or Synology NAS as a hosting provider, listing repositories over SSH commands. It also supports private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances, so the app talks to the user's own servers directly. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no cloud relay or intermediary is involved, and independent hands-on corroboration of direct self-hosted connections.
